description_uz: Statik elektr, elektronlar va zaryadlarning o‘zaro ta’siri haqida 4 savol.
description_en: Four questions about static electricity, electrons and electric charges.

questions.question_uz: Jismda elektr zaryadi to‘planib qolishi qanday hodisa deyiladi?
questions.question_en: What is the build-up of electric charge on an object called?
options_en: Continuous electric current
Static electricity
Magnetic induction
Heat transfer
questions.explanation_uz: Statik elektrda zaryad bir joyda to‘planadi. Elektr toki esa zaryadning oqishi bilan bog‘liq.
questions.explanation_en: Static electricity involves a build-up of charge. Electric current involves the flow of charge.

evidence.quote:
Elektr bir joyda
to‘plansa, bu statik elektr deb ataladi
evidence.learning_objective: Distinguish static charge from current.

questions.question_uz: Elektron qanday elektr zaryadiga ega?
questions.question_en: What electric charge does an electron have?
options_en: Positive
Neutral
Positive or negative depending on temperature
Negative
questions.explanation_uz: Elektron manfiy zaryadga ega; proton esa musbat zaryadli zarrachadir.
questions.explanation_en: An electron has a negative charge; a proton has a positive charge.

evidence.quote: Har bir elektron manfiy zaryadga ega.
evidence.learning_objective: Identify the charge of an electron.

questions.question_uz: Neytral atomda qaysi zarrachalarning soni teng bo‘ladi?
questions.question_en: Which particles are equal in number in a neutral atom?
options_en: Protons and electrons
Protons and neutrons
Neutrons and electrons
All particles in the nucleus and electrons
questions.explanation_uz: Musbat protonlar va manfiy elektronlarning soni teng bo‘lsa, umumiy zaryad nol bo‘ladi.
questions.explanation_en: Equal numbers of positive protons and negative electrons give a net charge of zero.

evidence.quote:
Har bir atomda odatda bir
xil miqdorda elektronlar va musbat
zaryadli zarrachalar — protonlar bo‘ladi
evidence.learning_objective: Explain electrical neutrality.

questions.question_uz: Ikki soch tolasi bir xil ishorali zaryad olsa, ular qanday ta’sirlashadi?
questions.question_en: How do two strands of hair interact if they acquire charges with the same sign?
options_uz: Bir-biriga elektr kuchi bilan ta’sir qilmaydi
options_en: They attract each other
They exert no electric force on each other
They repel each other
They attract when close and repel when farther apart
questions.explanation_uz: Bir xil ishorali zaryadlar bir-birini itaradi. Maqolada soch tolalarining uzoqlashishi shu bilan tushuntirilgan.
questions.explanation_en: Charges with the same sign repel. The article uses this to explain why charged hair strands spread apart.

evidence.quote:
Bir xil ishorali zaryadlar bir-birini itargani sababli soch tolalari
bir-biridan uzoqlashadi.
evidence.learning_objective: Apply the rule for like charges.

title_en: How does electricity reach our homes?
description_uz: Elektr ishlab chiqarish, uzatish va taqsimlashni tushunishga yordam beradigan 4 savol.
description_en: Four questions about generating, transmitting and distributing electricity.

questions.question_uz: Elektr tarmog‘idagi uch asosiy bosqich qaysi tartibda keladi?
questions.question_en: What is the order of the three main stages in an electricity grid?
options_en: Distribution → transmission → generation
Transmission → generation → distribution
Generation → transmission → distribution
Generation → distribution → transmission
questions.explanation_uz: Elektr avval ishlab chiqariladi, keyin uzoq masofaga uzatiladi va oxirida iste’molchilarga taqsimlanadi.
questions.explanation_en: Electricity is generated, transmitted over distances and then distributed to consumers.

evidence.quote: Elektr energiyasini ishlab chiqarish, uzatish va taqsimlashni tushunish
evidence.learning_objective: Identify the sequence of grid stages.

questions.question_uz: Elektr energiyasini uzoq masofaga uzatishda kuchlanish nega oshiriladi?
questions.question_en: Why is voltage increased when electricity is transmitted over long distances?
options_uz: Uzatish simlarining qarshiligini nolga tushirish uchun
Stansiya ishlab chiqargan energiyani o‘z-o‘zidan ko‘paytirish uchun
Yuqori kuchlanishni uy qurilmalariga o‘zgartirmay yetkazish uchun
options_en: To reduce energy losses during transmission
To reduce the resistance of transmission wires to zero
To automatically multiply the energy generated at the power station
To deliver high voltage to household appliances without reducing it
questions.explanation_uz: Yuqori kuchlanishli liniyalar uzoq masofaga uzatishda ortiqcha energiya yo‘qotilishini kamaytirishga xizmat qiladi.
questions.explanation_en: High-voltage lines help reduce energy losses when electricity is transmitted over long distances.

evidence.quote:
yuqori kuchlanishli uzatish
liniyalaridan foydalaniladi , bunday liniyalar tizimi ortiqcha energiya yo'qotilishining oldini oladi.
evidence.learning_objective: Explain the purpose of high-voltage transmission.

questions.question_uz: Elektr uyga yetkazilishidan oldin yuqori kuchlanish qaysi qurilma yordamida pasaytiriladi?
questions.question_en: Which device reduces high voltage before electricity is delivered to homes?
options_en: Generator
Battery
Solar panel
Transformer
questions.explanation_uz: Taqsimlash bosqichida maxsus transformatorlar kuchlanishni pasaytiradi. Shundan so‘ng elektr iste’molchilarga yetkaziladi.
questions.explanation_en: During distribution, transformers reduce the voltage before electricity reaches consumers.

evidence.quote: elektr energiyasining kuchlanishi maxsus transformatorlar orqali pasaytiriladi
evidence.learning_objective: Identify the role of a distribution transformer.

questions.question_uz: Muhandislar elektr tarmog‘ining holatini kuzatishni yaxshilamoqchi. Maqoladagi qaysi yechim bunga mos?
questions.question_en: Engineers want to monitor the grid more effectively. Which solution in the article fits this goal?
options_en: Switching a power station to a different fuel
Digital monitoring and automation
Installing additional energy storage batteries
Increasing the capacity of transmission lines
questions.explanation_uz: Maqolada raqamli monitoring hamda avtomatlashtirish tarmoq muammolarini bartaraf etishga qaratilgan yondashuvlar qatorida keltirilgan.
questions.explanation_en: The article lists digital monitoring and automation among approaches for addressing grid problems.

evidence.quote: Raqamli monitoring hamda avtomatlashtirish
evidence.learning_objective: Match a grid improvement to a practical need.

source_title: Aqlli uy texnologiyasida sun’iy intellekt va elektrotexnika muhandislarining roli
title_en: How does a smart home work?
description_uz: Sun’iy intellekt, sensorlar va muhandislarning aqlli uydagi vazifalari.
description_en: Explore the roles of AI, sensors and engineers in a smart home.

questions.question_uz: Aqlli uyda sun’iy intellektning asosiy vazifasi qaysi?
questions.question_en: What is a main role of AI in a smart home?
options_uz: Odatlarni o‘rganib, avtomatik qarorlar qabul qilish
options_en: Directly measuring temperature and converting it into a signal
Storing electrical energy in a battery
Physically closing a lamp’s electrical circuit
Learning habits and making automatic decisions
questions.explanation_uz: Sun’iy intellekt foydalanuvchining odatlarini o‘rganadi va qurilmalarga avtomatik vazifalarni bajartiradi.
questions.explanation_en: AI learns the user’s habits and directs devices to perform tasks automatically.

evidence.quote: foydalanuvchining odatlarini o‘rganib, qaror qabul qiladi
evidence.learning_objective: Distinguish AI decision-making from hardware work.

questions.question_uz: Aqlli termostat foydalanuvchi uyda yoki tashqaridaligini bilsa, maqolaga ko‘ra qanday moslashadi?
questions.question_en: If a smart thermostat knows whether the user is at home or away, how does it adapt according to the article?
options_uz: Odam bor-yo‘qligidan qat’i nazar bir xil rejimni saqlaydi
Harorat o‘rniga xonadagi chiroqlar sonini boshqaradi
Sozlamani faqat foydalanuvchi har safar qo‘lda o‘zgartiradi
options_en: It keeps the same setting regardless of whether anyone is home
It adjusts heating or cooling to the situation
It controls the number of lights in the room instead of temperature
The user must manually change the setting every time
questions.explanation_uz: Maqolada termostat foydalanuvchining uyda yoki tashqarida bo‘lishiga qarab isitish va sovitishni sozlashi aytilgan.
questions.explanation_en: The article explains that a thermostat can adjust heating and cooling based on whether the user is at home or away.

evidence.quote: AI yordamida termostatlar foydalanuvchining qachon uyda yoki tashqarida bo‘lishini oldindan aniqlaydi, isitish/sovitish tizimini avtomatik sozlaydi.
evidence.learning_objective: Apply occupancy-aware temperature control.

questions.question_uz: Aqlli uydagi sensorlar sun’iy intellektga nima uchun kerak?
questions.question_en: Why does AI in a smart home need sensors?
options_uz: Buyruqni bajarib, mexanik harakat hosil qilish uchun
Qurilmalar orasida tarmoq xabarlarini yo‘naltirish uchun
Harorat, harakat kabi holatlar haqida ma’lumot olish uchun
options_en: To execute commands by producing mechanical movement
To route network messages between devices
To obtain information such as temperature and movement
To store previous data in memory
questions.explanation_uz: Sensorlar o‘lchov ma’lumotlarini beradi. Shu ma’lumotlar sun’iy intellektning qarorlariga asos bo‘ladi.
questions.explanation_en: Sensors provide measurements that AI can use to make decisions.

evidence.quote: Aniq ma’lumotlar berib, AI qarorlariga asos bo‘lishi uchun.
evidence.learning_objective: Explain why automated decisions need measurements.

questions.question_uz: Maqola aqlli uy yaratishda elektrotexnika muhandislarining qaysi vazifasini ajratib ko‘rsatadi?
questions.question_en: Which role of electrical engineers in creating a smart home does the article highlight?
options_uz: Apparat va elektr tizimlarini loyihalab birlashtiradi
Uy egasining ovozli buyruqlarini tanib, javob beradi
Har bir xonadagi haroratni bevosita o‘lchaydi
Oila odatlarini o‘rganib, avtomatik jadvallar tuzadi
options_en: Designing and integrating hardware and electrical systems
Recognising and responding to the user’s voice commands
Directly measuring the temperature in each room
Learning family habits and creating automatic schedules
questions.explanation_uz: Muhandislar sun’iy intellekt ishlashi uchun zarur texnik infratuzilmani yaratadi va qurilmalarni birlashtiradi.
questions.explanation_en: Engineers create the technical infrastructure needed to run AI and connect the devices.

evidence.quote: apparat va elektr tizimlarini loyihalashtiradi hamda integratsiya(birlashtirish) qiladi.
evidence.learning_objective: Identify the engineering role in a smart home.

description_uz: G‘altaklar, elektromagnit induksiya va mos qurilmalar haqida 4 savol.
description_en: Four questions about coils, electromagnetic induction and compatible devices.

questions.question_uz: Induktiv simsiz zaryadlash qaysi hodisaga asoslanadi?
questions.question_en: Which phenomenon is inductive wireless charging based on?
options_en: Electromagnetic induction
Electrostatic charge accumulation
Photovoltaic energy conversion
A chemical reaction inside a battery
questions.explanation_uz: G‘altaklar orasidagi magnit maydon orqali energiya uzatilishi elektromagnit induksiyaga asoslanadi.
questions.explanation_en: Energy transfer through the magnetic field between coils relies on electromagnetic induction.

evidence.quote: Simsiz zaryadlash qanday ishlashining siri elektromagnit induksiyadir:
evidence.learning_objective: Identify the principle of inductive charging.

questions.question_uz: Zaryadlash bazasidagi g‘altakka mos keluvchi qabul qiluvchi g‘altak qayerda bo‘ladi?
questions.question_en: Where is the receiving coil that works with the coil in a charging pad?
options_en: Inside the charging pad itself
Inside the power adapter connected to the wall socket
Inside the device being charged
In the antenna section of a Wi-Fi router
questions.explanation_uz: Maqolada baza mos smartfondagi qabul qiluvchi g‘altakni aniqlashi tushuntirilgan. Ikki g‘altak energiya uzatishda birga ishlaydi.
questions.explanation_en: The article describes the pad detecting a receiving coil in a compatible phone. The two coils work together to transfer energy.

evidence.quote: Signal mos keluvchi smartfondagi kabi qabul qiluvchi lasanni qidiradi.
evidence.learning_objective: Locate the receiver in a wireless charging system.

questions.question_uz: Qi belgisi bo‘lgan zaryadlash qurilmalari uchun standartning asosiy maqsadlaridan biri nima?
questions.question_en: What is one main aim of the standard for charging devices carrying the Qi logo?
options_uz: Barcha telefonlarni bir xil quvvatda zaryadlash
Barcha batareyalarning sig‘imini bir xil qilish
Har bir batareyaning bir xil vaqtda to‘lishini kafolatlash
options_en: Charging all phones at the same power level
Ensuring compatibility between supported devices
Making all batteries have the same capacity
Guaranteeing that every battery takes the same time to charge
questions.explanation_uz: Qi standarti simsiz quvvatlashni qulay va xavfsiz qilish hamda mos qurilmalar o‘rtasida muvofiqlikni ta’minlashga qaratilgan.
questions.explanation_en: The Qi standard aims to make wireless charging convenient and safe while supporting device compatibility.

evidence.quote: Qi logotipi tushirilgan barcha qurilmalarda moslikni ta'minlashdir.
evidence.learning_objective: Explain why a charging standard matters.

questions.question_uz: Maqolada rezonant quvvatlashning qanday imkoniyati tilga olingan?
questions.question_en: Which capability of resonant charging is mentioned in the article?
options_uz: Bir vaqtning o‘zida bir nechta qurilmani quvvatlash
options_en: Charging devices with no limit on distance
Transferring energy without a receiving coil
Charging continuously without an external power source
Charging several devices at the same time
questions.explanation_uz: Maqolada rezonant quvvatlash bir vaqtning o‘zida bir nechta qurilmani quvvatlashi mumkinligi aytilgan. G‘altaklar baribir bir-biriga yaqin bo‘lishi kerak.
questions.explanation_en: The article says resonant charging can charge several devices at once. The coils still need to be near each other.

evidence.quote: bir vaqtning o’zida bir nechta qurulmani quvvatlashi mumkin.
evidence.learning_objective: Recognise a capability of resonant charging.

title_en: How do sensors sense the world?
description_uz: Sensor vazifasi, signal sifati va foydali o‘lchovlar haqida 4 savol.
description_en: Four questions about sensing, signal quality and useful measurements.

questions.question_uz: Telefon ekran yorqinligini atrofga qarab o‘zgartirishi uchun qaysi sensor kerak?
questions.question_en: Which sensor helps a phone adjust screen brightness to its surroundings?
options_en: Pressure sensor
Light sensor
Gas sensor
Humidity sensor
questions.explanation_uz: Yorug‘lik sensori atrofdagi yorug‘likni sezadi. Telefon shu ma’lumotdan ekran yorqinligini moslashda foydalanishi mumkin.
questions.explanation_en: A light sensor detects surrounding light, giving the phone information it can use to adjust screen brightness.

evidence.quote: Chunki unda yorug‘likni “ko‘radigan” sensor bor.
evidence.learning_objective: Choose a sensor for a familiar task.

questions.question_uz: Transduserning vazifasi qanday ta’riflangan?
questions.question_en: How is a transducer’s role described?
options_uz: O‘lchov natijalarini vaqt bo‘yicha xotirada saqlash
options_en: Storing energy without changing its form
Routing data packets to their network destinations
Keeping a time-based record of measurements in memory
Converting one form of energy into another
questions.explanation_uz: Transduser energiya turini o‘zgartiradi; maqola sensorning muhitdagi fizik ta’sirni sezish vazifasini ham ajratib ko‘rsatadi.
questions.explanation_en: A transducer changes the form of energy; the article also distinguishes a sensor’s role in detecting physical effects.

evidence.quote: transduser esa bir turdagi energiyani boshqasiga aylantiradi.
evidence.learning_objective: Explain energy conversion in a transducer.

questions.question_uz: Sensor signalidagi shovqin kamaytirilsa, o‘lchovga qanday foyda bo‘ladi?
questions.question_en: How does reducing noise in a sensor signal help the measurement?
options_uz: O‘lchanayotgan miqdor o‘zgarsa ham natija bir xil qoladi
options_en: The result becomes more reliable
The sensor’s measurement range automatically expands
The physical unit of measurement automatically changes
The result stays fixed even when the measured quantity changes
questions.explanation_uz: Shovqin foydali o‘lchovga aloqasi bo‘lmagan signaldir. Uni kamaytirish o‘lchov natijasining ishonchliligini oshiradi.
questions.explanation_en: Noise is an unwanted signal unrelated to the intended measurement. Reducing it improves measurement reliability.

evidence.quote: Shovqinning pastligi o‘lchov natijalarining ishonchliligini ta’minlaydi.
evidence.learning_objective: Explain why low noise is desirable.

questions.question_uz: Haroratni o‘lchayotgan sensor obyektni o‘zi qizdirib yuborsa, qaysi talab buziladi?
questions.question_en: If a temperature sensor heats the object it is measuring, which requirement is violated?
options_en: Low noise in the output signal
A linear relationship between input and output
Minimal influence on the measured object
Lack of sensitivity to other physical quantities
questions.explanation_uz: Sensor o‘lchayotgan obyektning fizik holatini sezilarli o‘zgartirmasligi kerak. Aks holda uning o‘zi o‘lchovga ta’sir qiladi.
questions.explanation_en: A sensor should avoid significantly changing the physical state of its target, or it will influence its own measurement.

evidence.quote: Yaxshi sensor o‘lchanayotgan obyekt yoki jarayonga minimal ta’sir ko‘rsatadi. Bu degani, sensorning o‘zi o‘lchov jarayoniga aralashib, obyektning fizik holatini o‘zgartirmasligi kerak.
evidence.learning_objective: Apply the principle of minimal measurement disturbance.

description_uz: Quvvatlash, xizmat xarajatlari va batareyalarning hayot davri.
description_en: Explore charging, maintenance costs and the battery life cycle.

questions.question_uz: Uzoq yo‘lda elektromobilni quvvatlashdan xavotirni kamaytirish uchun qaysi yechim eng mos?
questions.question_en: Which solution best addresses concern about charging an electric car on a long journey?
options_uz: Har bir shaharda avtoservislar sonini ko‘paytirish
Avtomobil sotib olish uchun boshlang‘ich narxni pasaytirish
options_en: Increasing the number of repair centres in each city
Expanding battery recycling centres
Expanding the charging network
Reducing the upfront purchase price of the car
questions.explanation_uz: Maqolada quvvatlash stansiyalarining mavjudligi va ulardan foydalanish imkoniyati asosiy masala sifatida ko‘rsatilgan.
questions.explanation_en: The article identifies the availability and accessibility of charging stations as a key issue.

evidence.quote: Quvvatlash stansiyalarining mavjudligi va ulardan foydalana olish muhim masala boʻlib qolmoqda. Quvvatlash infratuzilmasini kengaytirish yoʻllarda elektrda harakatlanuvchi transport vositalarining sonini oshirish uchun zarur hisoblanadi.
evidence.learning_objective: Match charging infrastructure to a driver’s concern.

questions.question_uz: Maqolaga ko‘ra, elektromobilning texnik xizmat xarajatlari kamayishiga nima yordam beradi?
questions.question_en: According to the article, what can help reduce an electric car’s maintenance costs?
options_uz: Dastlabki sotib olish narxining yuqoriroq bo‘lishi
options_en: Having fewer moving parts
Having a larger cabin display
Increasing battery charging speed
Having a higher initial purchase price
questions.explanation_uz: Maqola ichki yonuv dvigatellariga nisbatan kamroq harakatlanuvchi qismlar va kamroq xizmat talabini xarajatlarni kamaytiruvchi omillar sifatida keltiradi.
questions.explanation_en: The article links fewer moving parts and reduced maintenance needs compared with combustion engines to lower running costs.

evidence.quote: kamroq harakatlanuvchi qismlar tufayli kamroq operatsion xarajatlarga ega.
evidence.learning_objective: Connect mechanical simplicity with maintenance needs.

questions.question_uz: Elektromobilni quvvatlashning ekologik foydasini oshirish uchun qaysi manbadan foydalanish taklif qilingan?
questions.question_en: Which energy sources are suggested to increase the environmental benefit of charging an electric car?
options_en: A coal-fired power station
A petrol generator
A diesel generator
Solar or wind energy
questions.explanation_uz: Quyosh va shamol qayta tiklanuvchi energiya manbalaridir. Maqola ulardan quvvatlashda foydalanishni taklif qiladi.
questions.explanation_en: Solar and wind are renewable sources. The article suggests using them to charge electric vehicles.

evidence.quote: Ularni quyosh yoki shamol energiyasi bilan zaryadlash orqali
evidence.learning_objective: Recognise renewable-powered charging.

questions.question_uz: Ishlatilgan elektromobil batareyalarining atrof-muhitga ta’sirini kamaytirish uchun nima muhim?
questions.question_en: What is important for reducing the environmental impact of used electric-car batteries?
options_uz: Batareyalarni qayta ishlamasdan uzoq muddat saqlash
options_en: Storing batteries long-term without recycling them
Developing effective recycling systems
Mixing batteries with other waste without sorting them
Replacing only the battery’s outer casing
questions.explanation_uz: Batareyani ishlab chiqarish va undan foydalanish tugagach ishlov berish ham muhim. Maqola samarali qayta ishlash usullarini tavsiya qiladi.
questions.explanation_en: Battery production and end-of-life handling both matter. The article recommends effective recycling methods.

evidence.quote: Samarali qayta ishlash uslublarini joriy etish va uzoq vaqtga chidaydigan xomashyolardan foydalanish, ushbu zararli taʼsirlarni kamaytirishda muhim oʻrin tutadi.
evidence.learning_objective: Consider battery impacts beyond driving.

description_uz: Jarayonlar, zavodlar, ekologiya va biomassa haqida 4 savol.
description_en: Four questions about processes, factories, the environment and biomass.

questions.question_uz: Yangi kimyoviy mahsulotni ko‘p miqdorda ishlab chiqarish uchun kimyo muhandisi nima loyihalaydi?
questions.question_en: What does a chemical engineer design to manufacture a new chemical product at scale?
options_uz: Laboratoriyadagi kichik tajribani o‘zgartirmay takrorlash rejasini
Zarur zavodlar va ishlab chiqarish jarayonlarini
options_en: A plan to repeat the same small laboratory experiment unchanged
A method of writing the substance’s chemical formula
Routes for transporting the finished product
The required plants and production processes
questions.explanation_uz: Kimyo muhandisligi moddalarni o‘rganish bilan birga, ularni ishlab chiqaradigan zavod va jarayonlarni loyihalashni ham o‘z ichiga oladi.
questions.explanation_en: Chemical engineering includes designing the plants and processes used to manufacture substances.

evidence.quote: ularni ishlab chiqarish uchun zarur bo‘lgan zavodlar va jarayonlarni loyihalash
evidence.learning_objective: Identify chemical engineering’s manufacturing role.

questions.question_uz: Zavodni alohida bosqichlar orqali tahlil qiluvchi “birlik amaliyotlar” yondashuvi nimani anglatadi?
questions.question_en: What does the “unit operations” approach to analysing a factory mean?
options_uz: Jarayonlarni faqat ishlatilgan xomashyo nomi bo‘yicha guruhlash
Har bir bosqichni alohida jarayon sifatida ko‘rish
Butun zavodni ajralmas bitta jarayon sifatida baholash
Uskunalarni vazifasi emas, o‘lchami bo‘yicha guruhlash
options_en: Grouping processes only by the name of the raw material used
Treating each stage as a separate operation
Evaluating the whole plant as one indivisible process
Grouping equipment by size rather than function
questions.explanation_uz: Tashish, aralashtirish va ajratish kabi bosqichlar alohida birliklar sifatida ko‘riladi. Bu murakkab zavodni tahlil qilishga yordam beradi.
questions.explanation_en: Stages such as transport, mixing and separation are treated as individual operations, helping engineers analyse a complex plant.

evidence.quote: Zavoddagi har bir bosqich alohida birlik sifatida ko‘riladi.
evidence.learning_objective: Explain the unit-operations approach.

questions.question_uz: Maqoladagi Leblank jarayoni tarixi muhandisga qanday saboq beradi?
questions.question_en: What engineering lesson does the article’s account of the Leblanc process illustrate?
options_uz: Ishlab chiqarish hajmi va tannarxni yetarli mezon deb olish
Baholashni tayyor mahsulotning tozaligi bilan cheklash
Mahsulot unumdorligi va chiqindilar ta’sirini birga baholash
Jarayon samarali bo‘lsa, ekologik tahlilni keyinga qoldirish
options_en: Treating output volume and cost as sufficient criteria
Limiting evaluation to the purity of the finished product
Assessing production performance together with the impacts of waste
Postponing environmental assessment when the process is efficient
questions.explanation_uz: Jarayon ishlab chiqarishda foydali bo‘lsa-da, zararli chiqindilar chiqargan. Bu ekologik talablar paydo bo‘lishiga sabab bo‘lgan.
questions.explanation_en: Although the process was useful for production, it produced harmful waste, contributing to environmental regulation.

evidence.quote: Jarayon samarali bo‘lgan bo‘lsa-da, ekologik jihatdan zararli edi. Juda ko‘p yoqimsiz hidli chiqindilar hosil qilardi.
evidence.learning_objective: Recognise environmental trade-offs in production.

questions.question_uz: Qaysi energiya xomashyosi maqoladagi biomassa tushunchasiga mos keladi?
questions.question_en: Which energy resource fits the article’s definition of biomass?
options_en: Organic agricultural waste
Coal
Natural gas
Crude oil
questions.explanation_uz: Biomassa o‘simlik va hayvonlardan olingan organik materialdir. Maqolada qishloq xo‘jaligi chiqindilari uning misollaridan biri sifatida berilgan.
questions.explanation_en: Biomass is organic material derived from plants and animals. The article includes agricultural waste as an example.

evidence.quote: Biomassaga yog‘och, qishloq xo‘jaligi chiqindilari, axlat va hayvon go‘ngi kiradi.
evidence.learning_objective: Identify a biomass resource.

description_uz: Protonlar, elektronlar, ionlar va izotoplar haqida 4 savol.
description_en: Four questions about protons, electrons, ions and isotopes.

questions.question_uz: Atom qaysi kimyoviy elementga mansubligini nima belgilaydi?
questions.question_en: What determines which chemical element an atom belongs to?
options_en: The number of protons
The number of neutrons
The sum of the numbers of protons and neutrons
The difference between the numbers of protons and electrons
questions.explanation_uz: Protonlar soni atom raqamini belgilaydi. Masalan, 6 ta protonli atom ugleroddir.
questions.explanation_en: The proton count determines the atomic number. For example, an atom with six protons is carbon.

evidence.quote: Atomdagi protonlar soni — uning atom raqami
evidence.learning_objective: Identify what defines an element.

questions.question_uz: Neytral atomning umumiy elektr zaryadi nega nolga teng?
questions.question_en: Why is a neutral atom’s net electric charge zero?
options_uz: Yadrodagi jami zarrachalar va elektronlar soni teng
options_en: It has equal numbers of protons and neutrons
It has equal numbers of neutrons and electrons
It has equal numbers of protons and electrons
Its total number of nuclear particles equals its number of electrons
questions.explanation_uz: Musbat protonlar va manfiy elektronlar zaryadlari bir-birini muvozanatlaydi.
questions.explanation_en: The charges of positive protons and negative electrons balance each other.

evidence.quote: Neytral atomda protonlar va elektronlar soni teng bo‘ladi.
evidence.learning_objective: Explain charge balance in a neutral atom.

questions.question_uz: 3 ta proton va 2 ta elektronga ega litiy ionining zaryadi qanday?
questions.question_en: What is the charge of a lithium ion with three protons and two electrons?
questions.explanation_uz: Protonlar sonidan elektronlar sonini ayiramiz: 3 − 2 = +1. Ion bitta manfiy elektronni yo‘qotgan.
questions.explanation_en: Subtract electrons from protons: 3 − 2 = +1. The ion has lost one negatively charged electron.

evidence.quote: Litiyda 3 − 2 = +1.
evidence.learning_objective: Calculate a simple ionic charge.

questions.question_uz: Bir elementning ikki izotopidagi proton va neytronlar soni qanday taqqoslanadi?
questions.question_en: How do the proton and neutron counts compare in two isotopes of the same element?
options_uz: Protonlar soni farqli, neytronlar soni teng
Protonlar soni ham, neytronlar soni ham teng
Protonlar soni ham, neytronlar soni ham farqli
Protonlar soni teng, neytronlar soni farqli
options_en: Different proton counts, equal neutron counts
Equal proton counts and equal neutron counts
Different proton counts and different neutron counts
Equal proton counts, different neutron counts
questions.explanation_uz: Izotoplarda protonlar soni bir xil, neytronlar soni esa turlicha bo‘ladi. Shu sababli ular bir elementga mansub bo‘lib qoladi.
questions.explanation_en: Isotopes have the same number of protons but different numbers of neutrons, so they remain the same element.

evidence.quote: Izotoplar bir xil protonlar soniga ega, ammo neytronlar soni farq qiluvchi
evidence.learning_objective: Distinguish isotopes from different elements.

description_uz: Energiya darajasi, elektronlar soni va qisqartirilgan yozuv haqida 4 savol.
description_en: Four questions about energy levels, electron counts and shorthand notation.

questions.question_uz: 2p⁴ yozuvida boshidagi 2 raqami nimani bildiradi?
questions.question_en: In the notation 2p⁴, what does the initial 2 represent?
options_uz: Shu yozuv bilan ifodalangan elektronlar sonini
options_en: The number of electrons represented by that term
The energy level
The total number of electrons in the atom
The number of p orbitals
questions.explanation_uz: Elektron konfiguratsiyasidagi oldingi raqam energiya darajasini ko‘rsatadi; harf esa turini bildiradi.
questions.explanation_en: The leading number in an electron configuration identifies the energy level; the letter identifies the type.

evidence.quote: katta raqamlar esa qaysi energiya darajasida joylashganini bildiradi.
evidence.learning_objective: Interpret the leading number in configuration notation.

questions.question_uz: 1s² 2s² 2p⁴ konfiguratsiyasida jami nechta elektron ko‘rsatilgan?
questions.question_en: How many electrons are shown in 1s² 2s² 2p⁴?
questions.explanation_uz: Yuqori indekslarni qo‘shamiz: 2 + 2 + 4 = 8. Maqolada bu kislorod konfiguratsiyasi sifatida keltirilgan.
questions.explanation_en: Add the superscripts: 2 + 2 + 4 = 8. The article gives this as the configuration of oxygen.

evidence.quote: indekslar yig‘indisi 8 ga teng
evidence.learning_objective: Count electrons from configuration notation.

questions.question_uz: Natriyning [Ne] 3s¹ yozuvidagi [Ne] nimani almashtiradi?
questions.question_en: What does [Ne] replace in sodium’s shorthand configuration [Ne] 3s¹?
options_en: 1s² 2s² 2p⁶ — neon’s configuration
1s² 2s² 2p⁶ 3s¹ — sodium’s complete configuration
3s¹ — sodium’s outermost electron
2s² 2p⁶ — only neon’s outer shell
questions.explanation_uz: [Ne] neonning to‘liq elektron konfiguratsiyasini qisqartirib yozadi. Natriyning qolgan elektroni 3s¹ bilan ko‘rsatiladi.
questions.explanation_en: [Ne] abbreviates neon’s complete electron configuration. Sodium’s remaining electron is shown as 3s¹.

evidence.quote: Chunki Neon quyidagi konfiguratsiyaga ega: 1s^2 2s^2 2p^6.
evidence.learning_objective: Interpret noble-gas shorthand.

questions.question_uz: Maqoladagi 4 elektronli berilliy uchun qaysi konfiguratsiya to‘g‘ri?
questions.question_en: Which configuration does the article give for beryllium with four electrons?
options_en: 1s² 2s¹
1s² 2s² 2p²
1s² 2s²
1s¹
questions.explanation_uz: Berilliy uchun 1s² 2s² yoziladi: ikki va yana ikki elektron, jami to‘rtta.
questions.explanation_en: Beryllium is written as 1s² 2s²: two plus two electrons, four in total.

evidence.quote:
berilliy uchun to‘g‘ri konfiguratsiyani bildiradi:
1s^2 2s^2
evidence.learning_objective: Connect an example configuration to its electron count.

description_uz: Qattiq, suyuq va gaz holatlari hamda ularning o‘zgarishi.
description_en: Explore solids, liquids, gases and changes of state.

questions.question_uz: Suvni boshqa shakldagi idishga quysak, suyuqlikning qaysi xossasi ko‘rinadi?
questions.question_en: Which property of a liquid is illustrated by pouring water into a differently shaped container?
options_uz: Har doim butun idishni gazdek to‘ldiradi
Shaklini saqlaydi, lekin hajmi idishga qarab o‘zgaradi
options_en: It changes neither its shape nor its volume
It always fills the whole container like a gas
It keeps its volume but takes the container’s shape
It keeps its shape, but its volume changes with the container
questions.explanation_uz: Suyuqlikning aniq hajmi bor, lekin o‘ziga xos qat’iy shakli yo‘q. U idish shaklini oladi.
questions.explanation_en: A liquid has a definite volume but no fixed shape of its own, so it takes the shape of its container.

evidence.quote: Suyuqlikda aniq hajmga ega bo'lgan, ammo aniq shaklga ega bo'lmagan modda holatidir. Boshqacha qilib aytganda, suyuqliklar o'zlari joylashgan idishning shaklini oladi.
evidence.learning_objective: Apply the shape and volume properties of liquids.

questions.question_uz: Gazning suyuqlikdan muhim farqi qaysi?
questions.question_en: What is an important difference between a gas and a liquid?
options_uz: Gaz butun idish hajmini to‘ldirish uchun kengaya oladi
Gaz idish shaklini oladi, ammo hajmi o‘zgarmaydi
options_en: A gas can expand to fill the whole container
A gas takes the container’s shape but keeps a fixed volume
Gas particles are packed more closely than those in a liquid
A gas is harder to compress than a liquid
questions.explanation_uz: Gazning aniq shakli va hajmi yo‘q. U mavjud idish hajmini to‘ldirish uchun kengayishi mumkin.
questions.explanation_en: A gas has no fixed shape or volume and can expand to fill its container.

evidence.quote: gaz butun idish hajmini to'ldirish uchun osongina kengayadi yoki siqiladi.
evidence.learning_objective: Distinguish gases from liquids.

questions.question_uz: Suv bug‘i suyuq tomchilarga aylansa, bu faza o‘tishi nima deyiladi?
questions.question_en: What is the phase change called when water vapour becomes liquid droplets?
options_en: Evaporation
Melting
Sublimation
Condensation
questions.explanation_uz: Kondensatsiya gazsimon holatdan suyuq holatga o‘tishdir. Bug‘lanish esa uning teskari yo‘nalishidir.
questions.explanation_en: Condensation is the change from gas to liquid; evaporation goes in the opposite direction.

evidence.quote: Kondensatsiya : Gazsimon holatdan suyuq holatga faza o'tishi.
evidence.learning_objective: Identify gas-to-liquid phase change.

questions.question_uz: Muz erib suvga aylanganda nima o‘zgaradi?
questions.question_en: What changes when ice melts into water?
options_uz: Suv molekulalari vodorod va kislorodga parchalanadi
Agregat holati o‘zgaradi, modda suv bo‘lib qoladi
Har bir suv molekulasidagi atomlar soni ko‘payadi
options_en: Water molecules split into hydrogen and oxygen
Its state changes, but the substance remains water
The number of atoms in each water molecule increases
A new chemical substance forms
questions.explanation_uz: Erish qattiq holatdan suyuq holatga o‘tishdir. Bu misolda modda o‘sha suvligicha qoladi.
questions.explanation_en: Melting changes a solid to a liquid. In this example, the substance remains water.

evidence.quote: muz eritilib suvga aylanadi, ammo u har doim suv bo‘lib qoladi.
evidence.learning_objective: Distinguish physical state change from chemical change.
